label: Bible Study
prompt: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his _____.
verse: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
note: Make your plans, by all means — but the LORD holds the pen for the next step.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy _____ and full of glory:
verse: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
note: Peter writes to people who never saw Jesus in person, yet love Him with a joy too big for words.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence, then was Haman full of _____.
verse: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence, then was Haman full of wrath.
note: One man wouldn't bow, and Haman was full of wrath — pride can't stand a single holdout.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy _____.
verse: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
note: Moses' boldest prayer; God answered by hiding him in a cleft of the rock and letting his goodness pass by.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art _____, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
verse: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
note: In Moses' song, God is 'the Rock that begat thee' — and Israel was 'unmindful' of him. Forgetting is a spiritual act.
